sentence: The status feed still runs every morning: the letters still show on the Today tab's games table for your players, and tiers and availability still drive the lineup and the brief.
The deck proposes; it changes nothing on either plane.
The page changes nothing by itself, and tomorrow at 6:52 your time it updates itself for the first time.
- **Every in-season morning will crash the same way until the Movers code is fixed.** Tomorrow's runner build will publish a page with the same fault.
**D-INT-1 — the provenance writer.** Unchanged from last night; still yours.
